title: AIDA by DarGlobal - Oman
text: AIDA is a DarGlobal exclusive gated community and golfing destination in Muscat, Oman, overlooking the sea and situated in hilltops 130 metres above sea level. It is approximately 75 minutes from Dubai. The development combines coastal living with nature and offers villas, apartments, hotel rooms, a golf club, resort amenities, retail, dining, wellness and outdoor activities.

title: AIDA by DarGlobal - Property Types
text: The property types at AIDA include villas, apartments and hotel rooms. The Great Escape and Great Escape 2 are residential concepts within AIDA.

title: AIDA by DarGlobal - Amenities
text: AIDA amenities include plazas, cafes and restaurants, a fitness centre, mountain bike trails, outdoor landscapes, viewing decks, swimming pools, promenades, community and retail centres, wellness centres, hiking trails, a life-size chess board, running trails, children's splash areas and parks.

title: AIDA by DarGlobal - Branded Partners
text: AIDA includes branded experiences and partnerships with Marriott and Trump, including the Trump International Golf Club in Oman and The Trump Members Only Club. Facilities listed by the project include SHFT Night Club, AIDA Beach, the Hanging Suites and five-star culinary offerings.

title: DarGlobal - International Luxury Real Estate Developer
text: DarGlobal describes itself as a London-listed luxury real estate developer, investor, and asset manager creating communities and destinations across global markets including the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain, and London.

title: DarGlobal - Global Presence
text: Publicly indexed DarGlobal property information references projects across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, Spain, London, Greece, and the Maldives.

title: DarGlobal - Property and hospitality projects
text: DarGlobal public project information includes luxury apartments, residences, villas, masterplanned communities, hotels, and branded destinations. Specific availability, prices, payment plans, and handover dates must be confirmed from the current official listing or sales representative.

title: Wasalt - Saudi Real Estate Platform
text: Wasalt describes itself as a Saudi real estate platform for properties in Saudi Arabia, including apartments, villas, land, listings for sale and rent, and access to real estate experts. It indicates that it is licensed by the Real Estate General Authority (REGA).

title: Wasalt - Property search
text: Wasalt public pages provide property discovery for Saudi cities including Riyadh, Jeddah, Makkah, and Madinah. Users can search for apartments, villas, and land for sale or rent.

title: Wasalt - Saudi Real Estate Services
text: Wasalt public information references AI-backed verified property, project, masterplan, auction, and rental discovery services. Listing processes and live listing details should be verified through the current Wasalt platform.
